revision: H0 partially falsified: ESM-2 score_variant is NOT a reliable cross-position fitness ranker (Spearman ~0). It retains some within-position ordering value (at S12, higher ESM-2=A,T>N,Q,G matched beneficial vs deleterious). Predictive use should be restricted to ranking substitutions within a position once a beneficial position is identified by measurement.
reason: Measured Spearman(ESM-2, fitness)=0.009 over 20 variants; the highest-ESM-2 variant (H40K +2.04) was the worst measured (-0.578). Cross-position ESM-2 magnitude is not a reliable fitness ranker.
